y-m-77-01.title: Bincika lambobin da ke cikin rahoton saurin tafiya komawa da dawowa
y-m-77-01.goal: Bincika ta lissafi cewa matsakaicin gudun tafiya komawa da dawowa na iya bambanta da matsakaicin sauƙi na gudu biyun, sannan ka bayyana lokacin da suke daidai.
y-m-77-01.material: Wani direban isar da kaya ya yi tafiya komawa da dawowa a kan hanya mai nisan hanya ɗaya 12 km. A tafiya ta je, gudunsa 30 km a awa ne; a dawowa kuwa 20 km a awa ne (a ɗauka babu tsayawa kuma gudu yana tsayawa daidai a kowace tafiya). Rahoton abokin aiki ya yi lissafi kamar haka.
y-m-77-01.thinking.0: Nemo layin rahoton da aka tsallake ba tare da dalili ba.
y-m-77-01.thinking.1: Duba ƙimar ta amfani da ma’anar jimillar nisa da jimillar lokaci.
y-m-77-01.thinking.2: Samar da nau’i-nau’i da dama na gudu da suka cika sharuddan.
y-m-77-01.prereq.0: A wannan aiki, “H3” lakabin wahala da matakin tallafi ne kawai a wannan rabon samarwa. Ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta ware wannan fanni ga wani aji ba. A ɗauka ana ɗaukar lissafin sana’o’in sakandare babba a matsayin babban mataki, kuma ka riga ka san rabo, kaso, matsakaici, da lissafin haruffa na matakin ƙaramar sakandare.
y-m-77-01.prereq.1: Gudu = nisa ÷ lokaci; ma’anar matsakaici (matakin ƙaramar sakandare)
y-m-77-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a aikin abokin aikinka wanda ba shi da tallafi ko ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, bambanta ko yana sake faɗin sharuddan matsalar ne kawai (nisa, gudu) ko kuma yana ƙara sabon hukunci.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo lokacin da aka ɗauka a tafiyar zuwa da lokacin dawowa, rubuta jimillarsu, sannan ka sanya ƙimar kusa da lissafin lokaci a rahoton domin kwatantawa.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.0: Zuwa: tafiya 12 km da gudun 30 km a awa.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.1: Dawowa: komawa 12 km da gudun 20 km a awa.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.2: Matsakaicin gudu shi ne matsakaicin gudun biyun, saboda haka (30+20)÷2 = 25 km/h.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.line.3: Za a iya yin tafiyar komawa da dawowa mai nisan 24 km da gudun 25 km a awa, saboda haka lokacin shi ne 24÷25 = 0.96 hours.
y-m-77-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 da na 2 sun sake kwafe sharuddan ne kawai, saboda haka daidai ne. Matsalar tana farawa a layi na 3. Matsakaicin gudu shi ne “jimillar nisa ÷ jimillar lokaci”, amma ko da lokutan zuwa da dawowa sun bambanta, an yi matsakaicin gudun biyu kamar nauyinsu ɗaya ne. A zahiri tafiya zuwa tana ɗaukar 12÷30=0.4 hours, dawowa kuma 12÷20=0.6 hours, saboda haka duk tafiyar tana ɗaukar awa 1, matsakaicin gudun kuma 24÷1=24 km/h ne. Layi na 4 ya yi amfani da 25 daga layi na 3 yadda yake, ya ba da lokacin kuskure 0.96 hours. Ko da ka zaɓi layi na 3 ko 4, ka gano layin kuskure, amma tushen kuskuren shi ne layi na 3.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauka ana tafiya a hanya ɗaya da gudun a km a awa zuwa da b km a awa dawowa. Samar da nau’i-nau’i biyu daban-daban (a, b) inda matsakaicin gudun tafiyar gaba ɗaya (jimillar nisa ÷ jimillar lokaci) cikakkiyar lamba ce. a da b cikakkun lambobi ne mabambanta daga 10 zuwa 100, kuma ba ruwansu da nisan hanya ɗaya. An riga an bayar da (30, 20) a matsayin misali, saboda haka kada a haɗa shi. Ana ɗaukar (a, b) da (b, a) a matsayin misali iri ɗaya.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sanya nisan hanya ɗaya ya zama 12 km, sannan ga kowane nau’i (a, b) da aka zaɓa nemo lokacin tafiya zuwa da lokacin dawowa, sannan ka tara su.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ga nau’i-nau’i da dama, tsara a tebur ko jimillar nisa da jimillar lokaci ke ba da cikakkiyar lamba, sannan ka duba abin da nau’i-nau’in da suke ba da cikakkiyar lamba suka yi tarayya a kai.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a da b cikakkun lambobi ne daga 10 zuwa 100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Don Allah ka sanya a da b su zama cikakkun lambobi daga 10 zuwa 100.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole gudun zuwa da dawowa su bambanta.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Wannan nau’i ne sabo na gudu biyu.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c3: An riga an ba da (30, 20) a matsayin misali. Gwada nemo wani nau’i dabam.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Matsakaicin gudun tafiyar gaba da dawowa cikakkiyar lamba ce.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Matsakaicin gudun tafiyar gaba da dawowa ba cikakkiyar lamba ba ce. Sake ƙididdige jimillar nisa da jimillar lokaci.
y-m-77-01.s.s2.explain: Misali, idan nisan hanya ɗaya d ne, lokacin tafiya shi ne d/a+d/b, kuma matsakaicin gudu 2ab/(a+b) ne. Ga (60, 40) sakamakon 48 ne; (40, 10) yana ba da 16; (60, 30) yana ba da 40. Ko wane nau’i ka zaɓa, matsakaicin gudu bai fi sauƙaƙƙen matsakaicin gudun biyun ba. Daidaituwa da sauƙaƙƙen matsakaici tana faruwa ne idan gudun biyun iri ɗaya ne kawai.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.prompt: Ka bayyana wa abokin aikinka “dalilin da ya sa matsakaicin ba 25 ba ne”. Yi amfani da lokutan zuwa da dawowa a matsayin hujja, sannan ka ƙara jimla guda kan ko akwai yanayin da sauƙaƙƙen matsakaicin gudun biyu yake daidai.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta lokacin tafiya zuwa da lokacin dawowa a lambobi.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.hint.1: Gwada farawa da jimla da ke kwatanta lokacin da aka ƙididdige da 25 (0.96 hours) da ainihin lokacin da aka ɗauka.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana da kalmominka cewa lokutan tafiya zuwa da dawowa sun bambanta?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayar da ƙimar da aka ƙididdige daga jimillar nisa da jimillar lokaci a matsayin lamba?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka faɗi sharadi guda ɗaya na “yanayin da sauƙaƙƙen matsakaici yake daidai”?
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.0: Matsakaicin gudu shi ne jimillar nisa da aka raba da jimillar lokaci. Zuwa yana ɗaukar 12÷30=0.4 hours, dawowa kuma 12÷20=0.6 hours, jimillar lokaci awa 1 ce; tun da direban ya yi tafiyar 24 km, matsakaicin gudun 24 km/h ne. Dawowa ta fi jinkiri, saboda haka tana ɗaukar lokaci fiye, dalilin da ya sa ba 25 ba ne. Sauƙaƙƙen matsakaici yana daidai idan gudun biyun iri ɗaya ne, ko lokutan tafiyar biyun iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.model.1: Da a ce direban ya yi gudun 25, ya kamata ya ɗauki 24÷25=0.96 hours, amma a zahiri yana ɗaukar 0.4+0.6=1 awa. Lokacin da aka yi a gudun da ya fi jinkiri ya fi tsawo, saboda haka matsakaicin 24 ne, ƙasa da 25. Idan gudun zuwa da dawowa iri ɗaya ne, sauƙaƙƙen matsakaici zai yi daidai.
y-m-77-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Haka nan ana karɓar amsar da ta ba da sharadin sauƙaƙƙen matsakaici ya yi daidai a matsayin “lokacin da gudun biyun iri ɗaya ne”.

y-m-77-03.title: Kuɗin tattara kaya a akwati: shin ƙa’ida guda tana ba da mafi ƙarancin kuɗi?
y-m-77-03.topic: Raka’o’in tattara kaya da rage kuɗi
y-m-77-03.goal: Nuna ta lissafi cewa ƙa’idar “yi amfani da akwatunan da suka fi araha a kowane abu gwargwadon iko” ba ta tabbatar da mafi ƙarancin kuɗin wannan odar ba, sannan ka ƙirƙiri hanyoyin tattarawa da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗan.
y-m-77-03.material: Wani ma’ajiyar kaya yana son jigilar sassa 100 da aka raba zuwa akwatuna iri biyu. Babban akwati (L) yana ɗaukar sassa har 12, kuɗinsa 1,500원 kowanne; ƙaramin akwati (S) yana ɗaukar har sassa 8, kuɗinsa 1,100원 kowanne. Ana iya barin sarari a akwati, amma dole a tattara duk sassa 100. Ana iya amfani da akwatuna adadin da ake so. Wani ma’aikaci ya yi da’awar mafi ƙarancin kuɗi kamar haka.
y-m-77-03.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ko ƙa’ida (taƙaitaccen bayani) tana aiki
y-m-77-03.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar haɗin tattarawa da ke zama misalin karya ƙa’ida
y-m-77-03.thinking.2: Nemo sharuɗɗan da ƙa’idar za ta tabbata a ƙarƙashinsu
y-m-77-03.prereq.1: Rabo da saura a rabo, rashin daidaiton layi (matakin ƙaramar sakandare)
y-m-77-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya a da’awar ma’aikacin da ba ta da tallafi ko ba daidai ba ce.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko ka bincika da kanka ko lissafin layi na 1 da na 3 daidai ne.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirƙiri haɗe-haɗe da dama masu amfani da manyan akwatuna ƙasa da 8, ka bincika ko dukkansu suna ɗaukar sassa 100, sannan ka ƙididdige kuɗinsu.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.0: Babban akwati yana kashe 1,500÷12 = 125원 ga kowane sashe, ƙaramin akwati kuma yana kashe 1,100÷8 = 137.5원 ga kowane sashe.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.1: Saboda haka amfani da manyan akwatuna gwargwadon iko shi ne mafi arha.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.2: 100÷12 yana da rabon 8 da saura 4, saboda haka a yi amfani da manyan akwatuna 8 (domin sassa 96) da ƙaramin akwati 1 (ga sauran sassa 4).
y-m-77-03.s.s1.line.3: Jimillar kuɗin ita ce 1,500×8 + 1,100×1 = 13,100원, kuma wannan ita ce mafi ƙarancin kuɗi.
y-m-77-03.s.s1.explain: Lissafin farashi ga kowane abu a layi na 1 da lissafin quotient da ragowa a layi na 3 daidai ne. Layi na 2 ya ɗauki 'ya fi araha ga kowane abu, saboda haka a yi amfani da adadi mai yawa' a matsayin ƙa'ida ba tare da dalili ba. A hanyar layi na 3, ƙaramin akwati ɗaya yana da gurabe 4, amma idan aka yi amfani da manyan akwatuna 7 da ƙananan akwatuna 2, ana cika abubuwa 84+16=100 daidai, kuma kuɗin 10,500+2,200=12,700원 ne. 13,100원 na layi na 4 ba shi ne mafi ƙaranci ba. Ko ka zaɓi layi na 2 ko na 4, ka gano layin da ba daidai ba.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.prompt: Ta amfani da akwatuna manya a da ƙanana b, ƙirƙiri haɗuwar tattarawa da ke ɗaukar sassa 100 ko fiye kuma ta fi 13,100원 da ma'aikacin ya ambata araha. a da b integers ne da suka kai 0 ko fiye. Nemo haɗuwa biyu daban-daban.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.0: Canza adadin akwatuna manya a zuwa 5, 6, 7, da 8, sannan nemo mafi ƙarancin adadin ƙananan akwatuna da ake buƙata domin ɗaukar abubuwa 100.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, rubuta a jadawali ko adadin gurabe ya kai aƙalla 100 da ko kuɗin ya yi ƙasa da 13,100, sannan ka duba.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Adadin akwatuna integer ne da ya kai 0 ko fiye.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole adadin akwatuna ya zama integer da ya kai 0 ko fiye.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Wannan haɗuwa ba za ta iya ɗaukar abubuwa 100 ba. Sake ƙirga guraben akwatunan.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Kuɗin ya kai 13,100원 ko fiye. Nemo haɗuwa mafi araha.
y-m-77-03.s.s2.explain: Haɗuwa kaɗai da suka cika sharuɗɗan su ne (7, 2) da (5, 5). (7, 2) tana cin 12,700원 kuma tana da gurabe 100 daidai. (5, 5) tana cin 7,500+5,500=13,000원 kuma tana da gurabe 100 daidai. Babu wadda ke da gurbin da ya rage. Hanyar amfani da manyan akwatuna 8 sannan a saka sauran a ƙaramin akwati tana barin gurabe 4 a ƙaramin akwatin ƙarshe.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.prompt: Ga irin oda wanne ne za ka iya tabbatarwa cewa ƙa'idar 'yi amfani da mafi yawan akwatunan da suka fi araha ga kowane abu, sannan saka sauran sassan a ƙaramin akwati' tana ba da mafi ƙarancin kuɗi? (Farashi da girman akwatunan ba sa canzawa.)
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane oda, kwatanta kuɗin tattarawa bisa ƙa'idar da kuɗin idan aka yi amfani da babban akwati ɗaya ƙasa da kuma ƙarin ƙananan akwatuna.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta odar da ƙa'idar ke barin gurabe babu komai da wadda ba ta bari.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.a: Ko da sassa 98 ne, manyan akwatuna 7 da ƙananan 2 (12,700원) sun fi manyan 8 da ƙarami 1 (13,100원) araha. Wannan oda ce da ƙa'idar ta gaza.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.b: Guraben sun dace daidai da manyan akwatuna kaɗai, kuma babu haɗuwar da ke da farashi ƙasa da na wannan ga kowane gurbi; wannan shi ne dalilin.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.c: Kamar yadda ka bincika yanzu, ga sassa 100 akwai haɗuwa mafi araha fiye da wadda ƙa'idar ta bayar.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.o.d: Hakan yana faruwa ga kowane oda, ko yawan sassan nawa ne
y-m-77-03.s.s3.r.d: Domin a ce yana aiki ga kowane oda, dole ne a nuna babu misalin da ya karya ƙa'idar, amma tuni akwai misalin sassa 100.
y-m-77-03.s.s3.explain: Sassa 96 sun cika manyan akwatuna 8 daidai, kuɗin kuma 12,000원 ne. Ga kowace haɗuwa, farashi ga kowane gurbi aƙalla 125원 ne, kuma dole a sami aƙalla gurabe 96, saboda haka kuɗin aƙalla 125×96=12,000원 ne. Don haka 12,000원 shi ne mafi ƙaranci. Ƙa'idar tana daidai ga odar da akwatunan da suka fi araha ga kowane abu kaɗai suka cika daidai (ninkin 12), amma ga odar da ke da ragowa dole ne a bincika.

A ɗauka ana ɗaukar lissafin sana’o’in sakandare babba a matsayin babban mataki, kuma ka riga ka san rabo, kaso, matsakaici, da lissafin haruffa na matakin ƙaramar sakandare.
y-m-77-05.title: Idan za a shirya jerin farashi da 'ribar 25%', mene ne ya kamata mu fara tambaya?
y-m-77-05.topic: Tushen ƙimar riba da saita farashin sayarwa
y-m-77-05.goal: San cewa kashi ɗaya zai ba da ƙima daban-daban gwargwadon adadin da yake kaso nasa; sannan ka rubuta tambayoyi game da tushen da ya kamata ka bincika kafin saita farashi.
y-m-77-05.material: Wani shagon kayan rubutu yana son saita farashin da aka liƙa ga kaya mai kuɗin saye 8,000원. Jagoran ƙungiyar ya ce, 'Da fatan a saita farashin da aka liƙa da ribar 25%.' Riba ita ce farashin da aka liƙa a cire kuɗin saye (farashin da aka liƙa − kuɗin saye), kuma a yi watsi da haraji da sauran kuɗaɗe. Ma'aikaci 가 ya ce, 'Ƙara 25% na kuɗin saye, don haka 8,000×1.25=10,000원.' Ma'aikaci 나 ya ce, 'Dole rabon ribar cikin farashin da aka liƙa ya zama 25%, don haka idan farashin da aka liƙa P ne, to (P−8,000)÷P=0.25, wato P≈10,667원.'
y-m-77-05.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ko bayanin ya wadatar da nuna abin da ya ɓace
y-m-77-05.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar yanayi inda ƙimar rabo ke canzawa bisa adadin tushe
y-m-77-05.thinking.2: Rubuta saƙo domin tambayar ɗayan bayanin da ake buƙata
y-m-77-05.prereq.1: Ma'anar kashi-kashi da rabo, warware lissafin layi (matakin makarantar sakandare ta ƙasa)
y-m-77-05.s.s1.prompt: Wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa game da lissafin ma'aikatan biyu?
y-m-77-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta layi ɗaya kowanne game da abin da 가 da 나 suka ɗauka '25%' kaso nasa ne, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ta amfani da farashin da aka liƙa na kowane ma'aikaci, lissafa riba ÷ kuɗin saye da riba ÷ farashin da aka liƙa, sannan ka duba wanne ya zama 25%.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.a: Lissafin ma'aikaci 가 daidai ne. Ana ninka kashi da kuɗin saye sannan a ƙara shi, saboda haka ba a buƙatar lissafin 나.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunani game da kuɗin saye kawai. Ba ka yi la'akari da cewa za a iya bayyana riba a matsayin kaso na farashin da aka liƙa ma ba.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.b: Lissafin ma'aikaci 나 daidai ne. Ana bayyana ƙimar riba kullum a matsayin kaso na farashin da aka liƙa, saboda haka lissafin 가 ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi tunani game da farashin da aka liƙa kawai. Haka kuma ana yawan bayyana ƙimar riba a matsayin kaso na kuɗin saye.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.c: Idan muka saita kusan 10,333원, tsakiyar ƙimomin biyu, zai yi la'akari da lissafin 가 da na 나.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.c: Haɗa ƙimomin biyu yana ba da ƙima da ba ta dace da ko ɗaya daga ma'anonin ba. Har yanzu ba a warware bambancin tushe ba.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.o.d: Lissafin biyun daidai ne. Ya kamata mu tambayi jagoran ƙungiyar abin da 25% kaso nasa ne.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka gane cewa lissafin biyun sun yi amfani da tushe daban-daban, kuma ka fara ƙoƙarin tabbatar da wanne tushe ne.
y-m-77-05.s.s1.explain: 가 ya fassara ƙimar riba a matsayin kaso na kuɗin saye, 나 kuma a matsayin kaso na farashin da aka liƙa, kuma lissafin kowannensu daidai ne. Kalmar 'ribar 25%' ita kaɗai ba ta fayyace tushenta ba, saboda haka ba a ƙayyade farashin da aka liƙa a matsayin ƙima ɗaya ba. Idan ka zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin biyun bazuwar, yana iya bambanta da abin da jagoran ƙungiyar yake so.
y-m-77-05.s.s2.prompt: Yayin da bambancin farashin da aka liƙa bisa fassarorin biyun ke ƙaruwa, asarar rashin fahimta ma tana ƙaruwa. Idan kuɗin saye c원 ne kuma ƙimar riba m% ce, ƙirƙiri misalai biyu daban-daban inda bambancin farashin da aka liƙa bisa kuɗin saye (c×(1+m÷100)) da farashin da aka liƙa (c÷(1−m÷100)) ya kai 1,000원 ko fiye. c natural number ne a raka'o'in 1,000원, daga 1,000 zuwa 100,000, kuma m natural number ne daga 5 zuwa 50. Yanayin kuɗin saye 8,000원 da ribar 25% yana da bambanci kusan 667원, saboda haka bai cika sharuddan ba.
y-m-77-05.s.s2.hint.0: Riƙe kuɗin saye iri ɗaya, canza ƙimar riba zuwa 10, 20, da 30, sannan ƙirƙiri jadawalin bambancin farashin da aka liƙa biyun.
y-m-77-05.s.s2.hint.1: Riƙe ƙimar riba iri ɗaya, ninka kuɗin saye, sannan ka duba yadda bambancin yake canzawa.

y-m-77-06.title: Jadawalin aiki: shin za a sami ranakun hutu iri ɗaya nan gaba?
y-m-77-06.topic: Jadawali masu zagaye daban-daban da ranakun hutu na haɗin gwiwa
y-m-77-06.goal: Fahimci cewa jera wasu ranaku kaɗan ba tare da ganin haɗuwa ba ba ya tabbatar da cewa ba za a taɓa samun haɗuwa ba, sannan nemo, bayyana, da gyara ƙa'idar jadawali inda zagaye biyu ba su taɓa samun ranar hutu ɗaya.
y-m-77-06.material: Ma'aikaci A na shagon sayar da kayan yau da kullum yana hutu duk bayan kwanaki 4, saboda haka yana hutawa a ranaku 4, 8, 12, ... a kalanda. Ma'aikaci B yana hutu duk bayan kwanaki 6, kuma hutunsa na farko a rana ta 1 ne, saboda haka yana hutawa a ranaku 1, 7, 13, 19, .... Ana ƙirga dukkan ranaku daga rana ta 1, kuma a ɗauka cewa ƙa'idar hutun tana ci gaba ga mutanen biyu. A jerin ranakun hutunsu har zuwa rana ta 25, babu ko rana ɗaya da suka huta tare.
y-m-77-06.thinking.0: Sanin iyakar abin da za a iya cimma daga wasu misalai kaɗan da aka jera
y-m-77-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar jadawalin da ba ya da ranakun hutu ɗaya da kanka
y-m-77-06.thinking.2: Bayyana dalili ta amfani da ƙa'ida, sannan gyara ta hanyar canza abu guda ɗaya kawai
y-m-77-06.prereq.1: Ninki da rabobi, mafi girman rabon gama-gari, ma'anar ragowa (matakin makarantar sakandare ta ƙasa)
y-m-77-06.s.s1.prompt: Daga cewa ba su haɗu ba har zuwa rana ta 25, za ka iya cewa 'ba za su taɓa hutu tare a gaba ba'?
y-m-77-06.s.s1.hint.0: Jera ranakun hutun A da B har zuwa rana ta 40, sannan ka nuna ko suna da ranar da suka yi tarayya.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta wace lamba ce ranakun da ke cikin jerin biyun suke tarayya da ita, da yadda suke tarayya, a matsayin ƙa'ida.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.o.a: A ranaku 12 da 24, waɗanda su ne mafi ƙaramin ninkin gama-gari na 4 da 6, tabbas za su huta tare.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.r.a: Mafi ƙaramin ninkin gama-gari shi ne tazarar da zagayen biyun suke sake haɗuwa. Idan ranakun farawa sun bambanta, dole ne a bincika dabam ko wannan rana ranar hutu ce; B ba ya hutu a rana ta 12.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.o.b: Ranakun hutu suna ƙaruwa kullum, saboda haka za mu iya tunanin cewa lallai za su haɗu wata rana.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.r.b: Ƙarin ranakun hutu ba yana nufin za su haɗu ba. Jerin biyun na iya wucewa ta ranaku daban-daban kawai.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.o.c: Jerin kwanaki 25 kaɗai ba zai iya yanke hukuncin nan gaba ba, saboda haka dole ne mu bincika ƙa'idodin biyu.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka bambance misalan da aka jera da gaskiyar da aka bayyana bisa ƙa'idodin.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.o.d: Ba su haɗu ko sau ɗaya cikin kwanaki 25 ba, saboda haka za mu iya cewa ba za su taɓa haɗuwa daga baya ba.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.r.d: Ko da misalan da aka jera suna da yawa, ba sa tabbatar da 'koyaushe a nan gaba'. Dole ne ka bayyana dalili ta amfani da ƙa'idodin.
y-m-77-06.s.s1.explain: Ko da wasu misalan da ka lissafa kaɗan sun ba da sakamako ɗaya, wannan ba hujja ba ce cewa hakan zai ci gaba a nan gaba. Ko za a sami ranakun da ba su haɗu daga yanzu zuwa gaba, sai an warware ta hanyar bayyana ƙa'idodin hutun biyun (ninkin 4, da hutu duk bayan kwanaki 6 daga rana ta 1). Akasin haka, idan ko rana ɗaya ta haɗuwa ta bayyana, ikirarin cewa 'ba sa haɗuwa' ya ƙare.
y-m-77-06.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauka cewa ma'aikaci A yana hutawa duk bayan kwanaki p, ranar hutunsa ta farko kuma rana f ce; ma'aikaci B kuma yana hutawa duk bayan kwanaki q, ranar hutunsa ta farko rana g ce. Ƙirƙiri jadawali biyu daban-daban inda mutanen biyu ba sa hutu tare. p da q natural numbers ne daga 2 zuwa 12, kuma ranar farko ta hutu tana daga 1 zuwa zagayen kowane mutum (f bai wuce p ba, g bai wuce q ba). Jadawalin da aka musanya A da B ana ɗaukar misali ɗaya.
y-m-77-06.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ma'auratan zagaye kamar 4 da 6, canza haɗuwar ranakun hutun farko ta hanyoyi da yawa, jera ranakun hutu har zuwa rana ta 40, sannan ka duba ko sun haɗu.
y-m-77-06.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ka sami jadawali ba tare da haɗuwa ba, nemo kuma ka rubuta sifar da duk ranakun hutu a jerin biyun suke da ita.

y-m-77-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Da fatan ka sa p da q su zama natural numbers daga 2 zuwa 12.
y-m-77-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Ranar hutun farko tana cikin zagayen kowane mutum.
y-m-77-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ranar hutun farko ta kai aƙalla 1 kuma ta kai iyakar zagayen kowane mutum (f bai wuce p ba, g bai wuce q ba).
y-m-77-06.s.s2.ok.c3: A wannan jadawalin, mutanen biyu ba sa hutu tare ko sau ɗaya.
y-m-77-06.s.s2.fail.c3: A wannan jadawalin, daga baya za a sami ranar da za su huta tare. Ka tsawaita jerin ranakun hutu sannan ka nemo ranar haɗuwar.
y-m-77-06.s.s2.explain: Misali, (4, 6, 4, 1) ba sa haɗuwa domin A yana hutu a ranakun ma'aurata kaɗai, B kuma a ranakun marasa ma'aurata kaɗai. Idan zagayen biyu ba su da rabon gama-gari sai 1, kamar 5 da 7, tabbas za su haɗu daga baya. y-m-77-06.s.s3.prompt: Ta yin amfani da siffofin jerin ranakun hutun mutanen biyu, bayyana dalilin da ya sa A (duk bayan kwanaki 4, farawa daga rana ta 4) da B (duk bayan kwanaki 6, farawa daga rana ta 1) ba za su huta tare a nan gaba ba, sannan rubuta hanyar da za a sa su sami ranar hutu ɗaya ta hanyar canza ranar hutun farko ta B kawai.
y-m-77-06.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta ranakun hutu shida na farko na A da na B, sannan ka nemo sifa da jerin biyun suke da ita.

y-m-77-07.s.s1.o.a: Matsakaici ne da ke ba mu damar ɗauka cewa yawancin ma'aikata suna samun kusan 400만 원
y-m-77-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauka cewa matsakaici yana kusa da yawancin ƙimomin. Ƙimomi manya ko ƙanana kaɗan kan ja matsakaici cikin sauƙi.
y-m-77-07.s.s1.o.b: Matsakaici kaɗai ba ya nuna rarrabuwar bayanai, ana buƙatar wasu bayanai kamar median
y-m-77-07.s.s1.r.b: Ka nuna cewa bayanai na iya bambanta ko da matsakaicinsu ɗaya ne.
y-m-77-07.s.s1.o.c: Za mu iya ɗauka cewa aƙalla ma'aikaci ɗaya yana samun daidai 400만 원
y-m-77-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi tunanin cewa dole matsakaici ya zama ɗaya daga cikin ƙimomin da ke cikin bayanai. Matsakaici na iya bambanta da albashin kowane mutum.
y-m-77-07.s.s1.o.d: Matsakaici ne da za mu iya tabbatarwa cewa yawancin ma'aikata suna samun ƙasa da 400만 원
y-m-77-07.s.s1.r.d: Matsakaici guda ɗaya ba zai iya tabbatar da hakan ba. Wataƙila mutane da yawa suna samun ƙasa, ko kuma kaɗan ne.
y-m-77-07.s.s1.explain: Matsakaicin 400 yana nufin kawai cewa albashin wata na mutane 5 ya kai jimillar 2,000, amma bai nuna yadda aka raba shi ba. y-m-77-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko saita albashin wata mafi girma e ya zama ƙima babba kamar 500 ko 800, sannan lissafa jimillar da sauran mutane huɗun dole su samu.
y-m-77-07.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko albashin wata na sauran mutane huɗun duk ya yi ƙasa da 400; idan ba haka ba, daidaita ƙimomin.
